"""Six-hole rectangular block, dimensions in millimetres.

Requirements implemented:
R01: part-local origin at lower-left-bottom; +X length, +Y width, +Z thickness.
R02: block is 80 x 50 x 16 mm before hole subtraction.
R03-R05: six named plain cylindrical through holes, diameter 8 mm, parallel to Z,
         cut through the full 16 mm thickness at the specified positive XY coordinates.
R06: one resulting solid; no fillets, chamfers, counterbores, text, or extra components.
R07 analytical target: 64000 - 1536*pi = approximately 59174.5137 mm^3.
Downstream geometric validation is responsible for measured acceptance checks R06-R08.
"""
from steve import Model

model = Model("block")
model.box("block", length=80, width=50, height=16, at=(0, 0, 0), centered=False)
model.hole("h01", on="block.top", points=[(12, 12)], diameter=8, depth=16, kind="simple")
model.hole("h02", on="block.top", points=[(40, 12)], diameter=8, depth=16, kind="simple")
model.hole("h03", on="block.top", points=[(68, 12)], diameter=8, depth=16, kind="simple")
model.hole("h04", on="block.top", points=[(12, 38)], diameter=8, depth=16, kind="simple")
model.hole("h05", on="block.top", points=[(40, 38)], diameter=8, depth=16, kind="simple")
model.hole("h06", on="block.top", points=[(68, 38)], diameter=8, depth=16, kind="simple")
result = model.result()
